info.title: Home Center 0.18 Certificate Lifecycle API
info.description: Authenticated, secret-free certificate inventory and deterministic plan-only renewal policy API. No endpoint installs certificates, accesses private keys, or mutates services.

200.description: UTC-normalized certificate inventory ordered by certificate identifier

503.description: Certificate facts are unavailable or fail validation

post.description: Evaluates a bounded renewal policy against locally observed certificate facts. The result is a non-executable plan.

200.description: Deterministic planned or blocked renewal plan

400.description: Invalid or execution-capable policy was rejected

404.description: Certificate identifier is not present in local inventory

503.description: Certificate facts are unavailable or fail validation
